description: This file contains Data Transfer Object (DTO) classes used for document upload and metadata operations within a web API. It defines structure for requests and responses related to documents, including upload requests, metadata responses, and page requests for pagination.

classes.name: DocumentDtos
classes.description: A container class for various DTOs related to document operations.

classes.name: DocumentDtos.DocumentUploadRequest
classes.description: DTO for uploading a document, containing project ID and optional category.

classes.name: DocumentDtos.DocumentMetadataResponse
classes.description: DTO for responding with document metadata including ID, filename, content type, path, size, uploader, project ID, category, and upload timestamp.

classes.name: DocumentDtos.PageRequest
classes.description: DTO for paginating document list requests, with page number and size.
